turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What brought you in today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hi, um so I've had this terrible fever for the past three days um and just before that I had a stuffy nose um and I had a sore throat, well I still do, um and it's just not going away, so I thought I should just come in and see if I have covid or what it is.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so if I understand, it started with a stuffy nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and that kinda progressed to a fever?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been feeling any other symptoms aside from the fever?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Nothing really, have you had any nausea, any vomiting at all in the last little while?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any pain anywhere else in your body?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you have any neck stiffness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, no headaches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you been able to eat and drink during this time period?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Excellent. OK, you've had a cough at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No cough, OK and then how about abdominal pain, any pain in your tummy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Nothing like that, what about other changes in your body? Have you noticed any fevers or any rashes, any skin changes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. What about any pain in any of your joints and your knees, hips?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh, actually um not in my joints, but I've just, there there has been some muscle ache.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how long has that been going on for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh for the past two three days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So around the same time that you've had this fever?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Mhmm.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: That's right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Now have you had any contact with anyone who's been sick in the last little while?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, not that I can think of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any recent travel anywhere else?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I did go hiking um last weekend, um and it was about 2 hours away, um there were some people on the hiking trail that I passed by, but um other than that, no travel outside the province.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Does anyone around you or in your immediate circle come down with anything similar recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um my husband has also been experiencing similar symptoms for the past week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how's he doing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh the same as me.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you had any covid swabs recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and aside from the weekend hike, have you been mainly self isolating or?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, just me and my husband at home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you leave the house for work at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I work from home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, sounds good. So you have some muscle aches, little bit of fever, stuffy nose, sore throat, do you have any difficulty swallowing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, it just hurts.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so you're still able to swallow food, swallow liquids?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: It doesn't feel like anything is going down the wrong way or have any coughing after you swallow?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And just in terms of coming back to this sore throat, do you feel like you have any swelling around your neck? Does it feel inflamed or swollen?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Nothing like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright, excellent. So you're eating well, doing well, any changes to your bowel movements recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright, I'll just kind of go into other things, just in terms of anything else that you might have had in the past, uh have you ever been hospitalized for any reason in your life?

turns.text: OK, so that was around when you were 50 years old?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And any other surgeries you've had in your life?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, anything you've had to see a doctor for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I, in the past couple of years uh just for things like like this I guess um colds, um I'm pre diabetic, so I've been checking my glucose levels, yeah other than that nothing else.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So no high blood pressure?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No cholesterol issues?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so it sounds like you've been pretty healthy otherwise.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Excellent, OK. Do you have any allergies? To medications or otherwise.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Penicillin.

turns.text: Penicillin, what happens when you take penicillin?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I get a rash.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any trouble breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And what medications, if any, are you on?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I'm, I just take multivitamins, that's it though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And you said you lived with your husband in a house, um in London?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yes, that's right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What do you two do for work?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I work from home as a digital marketing agent and my husband is a computer programmer.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: Do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I drink once once in a while.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And when you drink, how many drinks do you have?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Got it. Any other recreational drugs, substances?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no,

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So no marijuana, heroin, cocaine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've tried marijuana before, just like edibles, but not, not regularly.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Understood. And have you ever used IV drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and when was your last menstrual period?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It was um a year ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: A year ago?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Mhmm.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And then otherwise, so we talked a little bit about recent travel. It sounds like you have the hiking trip last week and you passed some people, but it sounds like your husband also has kind of similar symptoms that you do right now.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Sounds good, now we've already talked about kind of past medical issues. Moving on, I think what we'll do next is move on to a physical exam. But before I do that, do you have any questions for me? Anything else you feel I should know?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, do you think I have covid?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: It's a possibility. It's always good to rule these things out, so we'll be ordering a covid swab no matter what. Obviously with any presentation where we have someone come in with a fever and sore throat, we want to rule out anything infectious. So it sounds like if your husband got it, and you have it, covid would be our first thing that we want to rule out. So just while we're trying to investigate, work this up further, I want to have you and your husband self isolate. The other question I suppose I should ask is, have you gotten your flu shot this year?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So it's also a possibility it might be influenza, just the seasonal flu. But until we, I suppose rule out covid, it'd be best just to keep to yourself just in case you are infectious for the meanwhile.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, sure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, well I'm going to go talk to the Doctor and I'll be coming back in to see you, OK?

turns.label: Patient
